<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="0.8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="160%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="1" stdDeviation="1.2" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F2EB"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="16" y="30" font-family="SF Pro Text, SF Pro, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="700" fill="#0A0A0A">08:22</text>
    <g transform="translate(305,18)">
      <rect x="0" y="8" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <rect x="5" y="6" width="3" height="9" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <rect x="10" y="4" width="3" height="11" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <rect x="15" y="2" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <circle cx="34" cy="8" r="3.2" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <line x1="31" y1="8" x2="28" y2="8" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="34" y1="11" x2="34" y2="14" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="54" y="3" width="22" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.4"/>
      <rect x="76" y="6" width="2.5" height="5" rx="1" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
      <rect x="56" y="5" width="16" height="7" rx="2" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Chat header -->
  <rect x="0" y="54" width="390" height="66" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
  <g transform="translate(16,67)">
    <g>
      <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="18" fill="#D0FECF"/>
      <text x="18" y="24" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#15603E">A</text>
    </g>
    <polyline points="52,21 44,13 52,5" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <g transform="translate(92,0)">
      <text x="0" y="16" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="16.8" font-weight="600" fill="#0A0A0A">Aisha Mensah</text>
      <text x="0" y="34" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">online now · last seen today at 08:19</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(294,4)">
      <circle cx="14" cy="14" r="14" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
      <line x1="9" y1="14" x2="19" y2="14" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="14" y1="9" x2="14" y2="19" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(327,4)">
      <circle cx="14" cy="14" r="14" fill="#0A0A0A08"/>
      <circle cx="14" cy="11" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <rect x="9" y="15" width="10" height="6" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#0A0A0A" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Encryption banner -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="52" y="126" width="286" height="34" rx="8" fill="#FEEECD" stroke="#00000012"/>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(68,135)">
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#767779"/>
    <line x1="4" y1="5.5" x2="4" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="8" y1="5.5" x2="8" y2="9" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <rect x="3" y="4" width="6" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="18" y="10" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Chat background pattern -->
  <g opacity="0.18">
    <circle cx="24" cy="190" r="1.8" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="54" cy="228" r="1.4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="324" cy="222" r="1.6" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="360" cy="286" r="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="40" cy="342" r="1.4" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="316" cy="396" r="1.7" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="460" r="1.6" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="346" cy="512" r="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="28" cy="612" r="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
    <circle cx="324" cy="690" r="1.5" fill="#D9D9D9"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="176" width="194" height="58" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <rect x="22" y="184" width="176" height="24" fill="none"/>
    <text x="22" y="199" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Morning! Did you get a chance to review</text>
    <text x="22" y="216" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">the mockup I sent?</text>
    <text x="168" y="229" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="120" y="247" width="256" height="72" rx="16" fill="#D9FDD3" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="132" y="265" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Yes — I went through it last night.</text>
    <text x="132" y="283" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Looks great overall. I have two small</text>
    <text x="132" y="301" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">notes on spacing and the header.</text>
    <text x="332" y="311" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
    <g transform="translate(333,258)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="9" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
      <polygon points="11,4 12.4,7.2 16,7.4 13.2,9.6 14.2,13 11,11.2 7.8,13 8.8,9.6 6,7.4 9.6,7.2" fill="#767779"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Incoming 2 with multiple messages -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="337" width="220" height="54" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="22" y="357" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Totally fair. Can you send the points</text>
    <text x="22" y="375" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">as bullet comments here?</text>
    <text x="183" y="388" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="164" y="399" width="212" height="54" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="176" y="419" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Also, are we keeping the green CTA</text>
    <text x="176" y="437" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">for both screens?</text>
    <text x="331" y="450" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Outgoing 2 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="92" y="470" width="284" height="72" rx="16" fill="#D9FDD3" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="104" y="489" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Yep. I’ll keep the CTA consistent and</text>
    <text x="104" y="507" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">update the action bar labels to match</text>
    <text x="104" y="525" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">the rest of the app.</text>
    <text x="349" y="535" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
    <g transform="translate(350,482)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="9" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
      <polygon points="11,4 12.4,7.2 16,7.4 13.2,9.6 14.2,13 11,11.2 7.8,13 8.8,9.6 6,7.4 9.6,7.2" fill="#767779"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Reply thread -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="563" width="300" height="68" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <rect x="14" y="563" width="4" height="68" rx="2" fill="#1DAB61"/>
    <text x="24" y="583" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1DAB61">Aisha replied to your message</text>
    <text x="24" y="603" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Perfect. I’ll share the annotated file by</text>
    <text x="24" y="621" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">09:00 after the design sync.</text>
    <text x="258" y="632" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="132" y="646" width="244" height="52" rx="16" fill="#D9FDD3" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="144" y="666" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Nice — send it when ready. I’ll leave</text>
    <text x="144" y="684" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">one last pass on the copy tonight.</text>
    <text x="321" y="695" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
    <g transform="translate(322,653)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="9" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
      <polygon points="11,4 12.4,7.2 16,7.4 13.2,9.6 14.2,13 11,11.2 7.8,13 8.8,9.6 6,7.4 9.6,7.2" fill="#767779"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Image placeholder card in thread -->
  <g>
    <rect x="14" y="716" width="160" height="104" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <rect x="14" y="716" width="160" height="68" rx="16" fill="#B1B5C0"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="740" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polygon points="28,784 48,761 61,774 71,765 92,784" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="24" y="804" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Wireframe_v7.png</text>
    <text x="24" y="820" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">238 KB · shared 08:22</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <rect x="186" y="718" width="190" height="70" rx="16" fill="#D9FDD3" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>
    <text x="198" y="740" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">Looks good. I’ve also added</text>
    <text x="198" y="758" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">a thumbs-up reaction to the</text>
    <text x="198" y="776" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">latest note.</text>
    <text x="347" y="786" text-anchor="end" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">08:22</text>
    <g transform="translate(348,727)">
      <circle cx="11" cy="9" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
      <polygon points="11,4 12.4,7.2 16,7.4 13.2,9.6 14.2,13 11,11.2 7.8,13 8.8,9.6 6,7.4 9.6,7.2" fill="#767779"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Reaction bubble -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="154" y="802" width="44" height="25" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F0E9DF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="168" y="820" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#0A0A0A">👍</text>
  <text x="182" y="820" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">1</text>

  <!-- Input bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="66" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
      <rect x="12" y="754" width="310" height="46" rx="23" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(26,766)">
      <circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="12.5" y1="12.5" x2="16.5" y2="16.5" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="24" y="13" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="15.8" font-weight="400" fill="#767779">Message</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(326,754)">
      <circle cx="23" cy="23" r="23" fill="#1DAB61"/>
      <polygon points="18,15 31,23 18,31 19.8,25 10,23 19.8,21" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom nav bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="810" width="390" height="34" fill="#F5F2EB"/>
    <rect x="153" y="822" width="84" height="5" rx="3" fill="#0A0A0A"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Decorative bottom tab-like icons -->
  <g transform="translate(16,812)">
    <g transform="translate(8,0)">
      <rect x="8" y="6" width="16" height="16" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="10" x2="20" y2="10" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="12" y1="14" x2="18" y2="14" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Chats</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(84,0)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="14" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="13" y="20" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#767779"/>
      <text x="16" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Calls</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(160,0)">
      <polygon points="16,6 25,12 22,24 10,24 7,12" fill="none" stroke="#1DAB61" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#1DAB61">Updates</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(236,0)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="12" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <rect x="10" y="19" width="12" height="5" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="16" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">Profile</text>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(312,0)">
      <circle cx="16" cy="12" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="16" y1="6" x2="16" y2="18" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="10" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12" stroke="#767779" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="16" y="31" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#767779">More</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Filler decorative bubbles to make the screen feel full -->
  <g opacity="0.18">
    <rect x="26" y="612" width="22" height="12" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="337" y="602" width="18" height="10" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="49" y="414" width="16" height="9" rx="4.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="309" y="176" width="22" height="11" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
